title: refactor: Unify the edgeMarker adding logic
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Simplify and unify the logic to add edgeMarker 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Keeping it separate will add more bugs when a PR modifies only one place. 

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.label_reasoning: The comment raises a security concern about potential SVG injection/corruption by passing unsanitized arrow type strings into SVG attributes (analogous to injection vulnerabilities), and suggests a safe allowlist approach to prevent invalid/malicious values from being inserted.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment flags a potential security concern (SVG corruption/attacks) and suggests a concrete alternative implementation to preserve the old behavior of ignoring unrecognized arrow types.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.label_reasoning: The comment specifically flags a potential injection vulnerability where malicious arrow type strings (e.g., containing `) url(https://my-malicious-site.example)`) could corrupt or attack the generated SVG output, and requests test coverage for this security concern.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment explicitly suggests adding a test case for invalid/malicious arrow types, including a code suggestion with the specific test to add.
